notes.title: Updated build for testing purposes
notes.content:
v0.8.0 includes several new updates from the previous version. 

- PCG islands and content with stronger terrain formations
- Updated progression flow with new stations and unlocks
- Players start in the air on a starter ship composed of makeshift pieces
- Enemy airship patrolling the skies searching for player built ships
- Improved combat behaviors and sequences (temp animations)
- and more...
